about.headline: Built for operators who need reliable software and intelligent platforms.
about.body: ZillionAI designs enterprise applications and AI platforms as one portfolio. Teams can start with a system of record, add an AI platform, or commission a custom Oqtane application.

values.title: Operational clarity
values.body: Software should make complex work easier to see and run.

values.title: Measured automation
values.body: AI is introduced where it reduces load, not where it creates noise.

values.title: Enterprise trust
values.body: Security, access control, and support are part of the product, not extras.

process.title: Discover
process.body: Understand current systems, workflows, and the outcome you need.

process.title: Design
process.body: Map modules, integrations, and where AI platforms should assist.

process.title: Implement
process.body: Configure, migrate, and train teams against real operating scenarios.

process.title: Operate
process.body: Support, iterate, and expand to additional products over time.
